# Vendored presentation library

Revision: 1 — 2026-10-17

`telegram_ui/` is an unmodified source snapshot of telegram-agent-ui v0.2.0,
commit `7e93214ed62c33bd838d9dd09a5bf79601c197f3`.
Source: https://github.com/antidark0605/telegram-agent-ui/tree/7e93214ed62c33bd838d9dd09a5bf79601c197f3
